title: Stand Up Paddleboard Lesson in South Lake Tahoe
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is the perfect way for beginner paddlers to learn how to SUP (Stand Up Paddleboard).

The water is usually smooth and glassy early in the morning, and that’s the best time to SUP (Stand Up Paddleboard). During this one hour session, you will receive introductory paddling instruction while enjoying the lake at its calmest. Learn techniques for entering and exiting the water, transitioning from kneeling to standing, body positioning, strokes, and tips for maximum efficiency, speed, safety and fun. This tour goes from 8:30 am to 9:30 am. Our instructors are highly qualified, with ACA instruction certifications and years of experience.

We have a 2 person minimum, so if you're travelling solo, we may only be able to do this lesson if someone from another party has booked for the same day.
